DHAKA, June 11 (Reuter)- Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to fall slightly on Wednesday amid typical pre-budget bearish trading, brokers said. "Selling might dominate as retailers are unlikely to take risks of making any fresh commitment before the budget," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed. The budget for 1997-98 fiscal (July-June) is due to be announced on Thursday. The DSE all-share price index dropped 14.13 points or 1.21 percent at 1,145.48 on a turnover of 59.9 million taka on Tuesday.
